evidence.locator: Ingesting the liquid produces the following properties in human beings: the ability to regenerate DNA damaged by sufficient duplication, heightened excitement of cellular duplication, vastly improved abilities in the repair of damaged tissue, and a frightening increase in the effectiveness of the human immune system.

effects.trigger: testing the liquid on animal subjects
constraints: many reptiles and birds were unaffected

evidence.locator: Upon testing the liquid on animal subjects, hostile bacteria and viral agents were destroyed immediately.

effects.trigger: personnel come into contact with SCP-006 or liquid from SCP-006

evidence.locator: If at any time personnel come into contact with SCP-006 or liquid from SCP-006, they are to be confined and terminated after sufficient studies are done.
